profiles.description:
I have seen many things in my time here in EVE. I have seen great friendships bonded in combat and torn asunder by politics. I have learned from well respected Fleet Commanders and I have earned the respect of many who put themselves under my command. I've fought many meaningless skirmishes, but found a few meaningful causes to have fought in. I have made many friends, but few enemies. I have seen the end of great empires in EVE, but I have learned that EVE never ends.

Well we're back in business boys and girls, just like the old days.
